brief_summary: Mirrored branch diagram. Left half shows one unaddressed complaint (Lumina Brown) branching into two declining tracker rows, Cherry brand (-2 to -20) and Cherry MX2A (-46 to -54). Right half shows one Kickstarter launch (V6 Ultra Hybrid) branching into two climbing tracker rows, Keychron brand (97 to 100) and Hall Effect/Rapid Trigger category (97 to 98). Visualizes the article's connective thread that both trajectories share a single-cause, double-row mechanism.
